disposition_reason: Text prints the across-food concentration ranges (wet basis) for Cu, Cr, Fe, Mn, Hg and Zn in 24 street vended foods; per-food values are figure-only.

study.design: Cross-sectional survey of street vended foods near four elementary schools
study.origin: Prepared by street vendors, Bandung, Indonesia
study.market: Street vendors around Setiabudi, Pelesiran, Sindanglaya and Soka elementary schools, Bandung city
study.method: Freeze-drying; NAA (Cr, Fe, Zn, Hg) and microwave digestion with flame AAS (Cu, Mn)
study.lod_text: not stated; Cu and Mn working range 1-5 and 1-3.6 mg/kg
study.qa: SRM NIST 1548a Typical Diet and 1567a Wheat Flour, recoveries 94-103%, CV 1-5%; Cr and Hg not certified in either SRM
